environment: Synthetic private test fixture only; no real human reviews were recorded
scope: Independent human relevance-review batch intake into immutable dataset successors
validated_behaviors: First and second distinct reviewer records preserve frozen content hashes and input version hashes.
Conflicting reviewer labels remain separate provisional records; no final annotation.labels is assigned.
Repeated reviewer, stale content hash, stale dataset hash, assisted-model attestation and invalid relevance label are rejected.
Existing output versions cannot be overwritten and failed batches create no output version.
limitations: Tests use synthetic identities and content solely to verify mechanics; no one is represented as having reviewed a real document.
The tool cannot prove a person's identity, independence, content inspection or lack of model assistance.
Third-person adjudication and task-specific impact labels are separate future work.
The latest real candidate holdout is still awaiting human leakage review before labeling.
